read.title: Out of Office: December 23-27
read.text:
Hi team,

Just a reminder that I'll be on annual leave from December 23rd to the 27th and will be back in the office on Monday, December 30th.

While I'm away, Jisoo will be handling all client emails and sample requests. Daniel will cover the weekly sales report. I've shared a handover document in our team folder with the status of each project.

I'll have limited access to email during this time. For anything urgent, please call my mobile, but I'd appreciate it if you could contact Jisoo first.

Thanks for your support, and happy holidays!

Best,
Minsu

write.en: Write an email to your manager requesting next Friday off and explaining who will cover your work.
hints: ... will be handling ... while I'm away.
write.model:
Hi Sarah,

I'd like to request next Friday, November 28th, off as annual leave. I'll finish the monthly report by Thursday. Jisoo will be handling any client emails while I'm away. If something urgent comes up, you can reach me on my mobile.

Thank you,
Minsu
